title: MNI Open iEEG Atlas: high-sampling-rate NREM sleep sEEG (normal high-frequency oscillations)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from 71 patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy during N2/N3 non-REM sleep, stored at the original sampling rates (512, 1024 and 2000 Hz). The data come from the MNI Open iEEG Atlas and were used to characterize normal high-frequency oscillations (HFOs). Only bipolar channels judged to record normal activity are included, with Talairach coordinates for each channel midpoint.
methods_description: Clinical presurgical stereo-EEG was recorded at three tertiary epilepsy centres with DIXI or MNI homemade depth electrodes (plus some subdural strips/grids). Twenty-minute sections of N2/N3 sleep were selected and bipolar derivations computed between adjacent contacts. Source int16 samples were repacked losslessly into BrainVision format with the source gain as resolution. No filtering or resampling was applied.
